title: Presolana rehearsal: 4h fuelling test, 1200m D+, descent capped 1100m
terrain: Presolana valley loop from the family trailhead, one sustained climb, back at the car by 11:00, family hike to Olmo in the afternoon

steps.target: Z2-Z3 single sustained climb ~1200m D+, 151-160 bpm
Z1-Z2 descent, capped 1100m, poles, cadence 175+, 99-144 bpm

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: out by 06:30, back at the car by 11:00. ONE sustained climb, ~1200m D+, no repeats, no summit out-and-backs, fixed line, load the GPX. Descent hard-capped at 1100m including rolling accumulation: poles, short stride, cadence 175+. PM: family hike to Rifugio Olmo, ~600m D+, walking only, sleep at the hut. That hike is inside today's 220 load, record it as a separate activity.
GYM: none.
FUEL, THE RANKED OBJECTIVE: 80 g/h from minute 30 to the end of the run. 1 Isocarb C2:1 Pro per 500ml, one bottle per hour, plus 1 Carbo Gel at hour 2 and hour 4. DRINK ON THE CLOCK: 125ml every 15min, not to thirst. That single instruction is the whole test. Keep sipping on the walk up to Olmo.
STOP RULE: no symptoms during, after, or next day. Lateral knee pain on the descent ends the descent, walk the rest out. If holding the intake means cutting the route, cut the route.
WHY 1200 AND NOT 1600: a closed loop back to the car makes D+ equal D-, so 1600m of climb means 1600m of running descent, 60% over the cap, and Sunday now adds another 600m walking down from Olmo. Climb capacity is proven (1933m at Clusone, 22 Aug); descent tolerance is not, and duration is what the fuel test needs, not metres.
